---
title: "ARU Review: beta testing"
---

```{r setup, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Password-protected beta download.
# The download link is NOT in this file or anywhere in the public repo in readable form:
# data/beta_locked.json holds it encrypted (AES-256-GCM, key from the password via
# PBKDF2-SHA256, 600,000 rounds). Make or replace that file with tools/lock_beta_download.html,
# then rebuild the site. The visitor's browser decrypts it only if they type the right password.
source("R/page_helpers.R")
show_banner("aru_review_beta", "ARU Review beta")
lock_file <- "data/beta_locked.json"
if (file.exists(lock_file)) {
  locked <- jsonlite::fromJSON(lock_file)
  cat('<script id="beta-lock" type="application/json">',
      jsonlite::toJSON(locked, auto_unbox = TRUE), '</script>\n', sep = "")
}
has_lock <- file.exists(lock_file)
```

<div class="beta-gate">

This page is for **invited beta testers** of a desktop app for reviewing acoustic recorder (ARU)
detections. If you've been invited, enter the password you were given.

```{r gate, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (has_lock) {
  # No indentation: pandoc would treat indented lines as a code block.
  cat('<form id="beta-form" class="beta-form" autocomplete="off">',
      '<label for="beta-pw">Password</label>',
      '<div class="beta-row">',
      '<input id="beta-pw" type="password" required>',
      '<button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Unlock</button>',
      '</div>',
      '<p id="beta-msg" class="beta-msg" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>',
      '</form>', sep = "\n")
} else {
  cat('<p class="beta-msg"><em>No beta download is available right now.</em></p>\n')
}
```

</div>

<div id="beta-content" class="beta-content" hidden>

<div class="beta-notice">
**THIS IS A BETA VERSION FOR TESTING ONLY.** Results are still being checked against pycnet and
Kaleidoscope. Please don't use its outputs for reports, publications or management decisions yet,
and please don't share the download link or password.
</div>

**ARU Review** runs PNW-Cnet (via pycnet-audio) on your recordings, lets you listen to and verify each
detection with customizable tags, and summarizes the verified results into Excel, maps and graphs, all
in one desktop window with no coding. Everything runs on your own computer; nothing is uploaded.

<div class="contact-button-wrap">
<a id="beta-download" class="btn btn-primary contact-button" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Download</a>
<p id="beta-details" class="beta-details"></p>
</div>

### Getting started

1. Download the zip (Windows 10 or 11) and **unzip it** somewhere permanent, such as Documents.
2. Open **`Setup guide.html`** inside it. It walks you through the one-time pycnet install (about
   20 minutes) and your first run.
3. The first time you open `ARU Review.exe`, Windows may say *"Windows protected your PC"*. Click
   **More info**, then **Run anyway**. This appears because the beta isn't signed with a paid publisher
   certificate.

### Feedback

Anything that's confusing, slow, broken or missing is useful, especially results that don't match what
you'd expect. If something goes wrong during a scan, the **Copy log** button on the Scan tab copies the
technical details to paste into an email.

</div>

<script>
(function () {
  var lockEl = document.getElementById("beta-lock");
  var form = document.getElementById("beta-form");
  if (!lockEl || !form) return;
  var locked = JSON.parse(lockEl.textContent);
  var msg = document.getElementById("beta-msg");
  var unb64 = function (s) { return Uint8Array.from(atob(s), function (c) { return c.charCodeAt(0); }); };

  if (!window.crypto || !crypto.subtle) {
    msg.textContent = "This page needs a current web browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari).";
    return;
  }

  async function unlock(password) {
    var base = await crypto.subtle.importKey("raw", new TextEncoder().encode(password), "PBKDF2", false, ["deriveKey"]);
    var key = await crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
      { name: "PBKDF2", hash: "SHA-256", salt: unb64(locked.salt), iterations: locked.iterations },
      base, { name: "AES-GCM", length: 256 }, false, ["decrypt"]);
    var plain = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: "AES-GCM", iv: unb64(locked.iv) }, key, unb64(locked.ciphertext));
    return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(plain));
  }

  form.addEventListener("submit", async function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var btn = form.querySelector("button");
    btn.disabled = true;
    msg.className = "beta-msg";
    msg.textContent = "Checking…";
    try {
      var d = await unlock(document.getElementById("beta-pw").value);
      document.getElementById("beta-download").href = d.link;
      document.getElementById("beta-download").textContent = "Download ARU Review " + (d.version || "");
      document.getElementById("beta-details").textContent =
        [d.size, "Windows 10/11", d.locked ? "updated " + d.locked : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
      document.querySelector(".beta-gate").hidden = true;
      document.getElementById("beta-content").hidden = false;
    } catch (err) {
      msg.className = "beta-msg beta-bad";
      msg.textContent = "That password didn't work. Please check it and try again.";
      btn.disabled = false;
    }
  });
})();
</script>
